evals.name: qualified-skill-invocation
evals.prompt: For product-design:share at target.path . (current skill root), explain how to invoke this installed skill in Goose for a focused handoff. The installed plugin namespace is product-design. Do not run the workflow.
evals.expected_output: An explain-only handoff using the exact instruction load skills product-design:share; no sibling SKILL.md link substituted as invocation.
assertions: The response gives the exact invocation `load skills product-design:share`.
The invocation resolves the actual installed skill name rather than leaving a {name} placeholder.
The response does not substitute a sibling SKILL.md file link for skill invocation.
The response does not claim that explaining the invocation executed the focused workflow.

evals.name: share-target-not-chosen
evals.prompt: For product-design:share at target.path . (current skill root), Explain the sharing plan for a runnable prototype when no hosting target is chosen. Do not deploy it.
evals.expected_output: An explain-only boundary plan; all operational checks remain not run. The response asks one focused question selecting an available hosting target. The plan does not deploy before target confirmation. The response does not treat Goose Apps creation as deployment. The response does not claim a working share URL exists.

The plan does not deploy before target confirmation.
The response does not treat Goose Apps creation as deployment.
